  PLEASE SILENCE CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE MEETING LOCATION

Viewing of City Council Meetings:
  • In-person – City Council Chambers, 613 E. Broadway, 2nd Floor, Glendale, CA 91206
  • TV Broadcast via Glendale TV, viewable on Spectrum Cable, channel 6, and AT&T U-verse,
  channel 99.
  • Live Broadcast – Streamed on the City webpage, glendaleca.gov/live, on
  YouTube.com/myglendale, and on the Cablecast app under "Glendale TV".
  • Online Attendance – via Zoom at https://glendaleca.zoomgov.com/j/1659278910
Meetings are also archived on the City Website for viewing anytime at glendaleca.gov/agendas.

City Council meeting agenda packets, any agenda related documents, and additional documents
are available at City Hall and online for public viewing on the City’s website:
https://www.glendaleca.gov/government/public-meeting-portal

ADA Accessibility and Translation Services:
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign
language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices
are available same-day upon request. The City Clerk’ office should be notified 72 hours (three
business days) or as soon as practicable for requests regarding sign language translation and
Braille transcription services; please direct all accessibility requests to (818) 548-2090. For
translations, please specify the language for which you require translation. The exclusive use of
City provided interpreters is not required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or
speak in their native language.

If you have any questions about matters on the agenda, or requests for assistance including
agenda email notification, please contact the City Clerk’s Office via email at
CityClerk@GlendaleCA.gov, or by phone at (818) 548-2090.

   PUBLIC COMMENT GUIDELINES
The City Council welcomes public input at City Council meetings. Public input at Council meetings
is regulated by the City Council’s Rules of Order, Procedure and Decorum for the Conduct of City
Council Meetings as set forth in Resolution No. 25-76, which will be summarized below.

Public Comment participation in Council meetings may occur as follows:
  • In-person – City Council Chambers
  • Online attendance – Connect to the meeting online using the meeting link below and use the
  Raise Hand feature to speak when the Mayor or City Clerk states it is time to speak on the
  particular public comment period or agenda item.
  Meeting link: https://glendaleca.zoomgov.com/j/1659278910 | Meeting ID: 165 927 8910
  • Telephone – Call the number listed below and dial *9 to request to speak | *6 to unmute / mute
  Meeting call-in telephone number: (818) 745-0355

Written Comments and Documents:
Public comments received in writing will NOT be read aloud at the meeting but will be part of the
meeting record. Written public comments can be emailed to citycouncil@glendaleca.gov, and will
be uploaded to the City website as an attachment to the agenda item. When submitting a public
comment, please make sure to include the following:
  1. Name (optional); and
  2. Agenda item to which you are submitting public comment
  3. Submit no later than 12:00 p.m. on the day of the City Council meeting. Correspondence
  received after this time may not be distributed until the following business day.
All documents related to open session items on this agenda that are received less than 72 hours
prior to this meeting, and are public records, will be available for review in the Office of the City
Clerk, 613 E. Broadway, Room 110, Glendale, CA 91206.

Public Comments During Council Meeting:
Public Comments during Community Event Announcements, First and Second Periods of Oral
Communications and agenda items will be governed as provided in the descriptions for those items
on the agenda below. Pursuant to State law, the City Council may not discuss or take action on any
item not appearing on the meeting agenda, except that members of the City Council or staff may
ask a question for clarification or briefly respond to statements made or questions posed by
persons exercising public testimony rights (Government Code Section 54954.2). Staff may be
asked to follow up on such items.

Submitting Speaker Cards or Requesting Online or Telephonic Participation for Public Comment:
Speaker cards must be submitted, by the following deadlines:
  • Community Event Announcements or First or Second Period of Oral Communications: PRIOR
  TO the commencement of the specific comment period
  • Consent Calendar Items: BEFORE a motion is made on the consent calendar
  • Other agenda items, including Action items: PRIOR to the completion of the verbal staff report
  (unless waived by the Mayor)
Online participants must raise their hands and telephone users must dial *9 after the Mayor or City
Clerk state it is time to indicate their desire to speak on an item but before the deadlines stated

  a. Proclaiming October 2026 as Filipino American History Month

5.  CONSENT ITEMS (Including Minutes)
  The following are routine and may be acted upon by one motion. Any Member of Council or
  the audience requesting separate consideration may do so by making such request before
  motion is proposed.
  a. Glendale Water and Power, re: Contract with Fairbank, Maslin, Maullin, Metz &
  Associates (FM3) for Glendale Water & Power (GWP) Customer Satisfaction Surveys
  and Focus Group Research

  1. Motion authorizing the City Manager, or his designee, to enter into and execute a
  Professional Services Agreement (PSA) with Fairbank, Maslin, Maullin, Metz &
  Associates (FM3) to provide services related to Glendale Water & Power (GWP)
  customer satisfaction surveys and focus group research, for a not to exceed amount
  of $115,750
  2. Resolution of Appropriation

   b. Community Services and Parks, re: Acceptance of Youth@Work funds from the Los
  Angeles County, Department of Economic Opportunity and award of contract to
  Glendale Youth Alliance
  1. Accepting the Youth@Work funds from the Los Angeles County, Department of
  Economic Opportunity in the amount of $158,100; and authorizing the City Manager,
  or a designee, to enter into and execute all agreements, amendments, certifications,
  and documents necessary to accept and implement the funding, subject to the
  approval by the City Attorney
  2. Authorizing the City Manager, or a designee, to enter into and execute a Contract with
  Glendale Youth Alliance in an amount not to exceed $142,600 from the Youth@Work
  grant for the period of July 1, 2026, to June 30, 2027, subject to the approval by the
  City Attorney
  c. Community Services and Parks, re: Acceptance of Federal Workforce Innovation
  and Opportunity Act funds from the State of California, Employment Development
  Department and award of contracts to the Glendale Youth Alliance and the City of
  Burbank
  1. Accepting the Federal Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act (WIOA) funds in the
  amount of $791,270 from the State of California, Employment Development
  Department; and authorizing the City Manager, or a designee, to enter into and
  execute all agreements, amendments, certifications, and documents necessary to
  accept and implement the funding
  2. Authorizing the City Manager, or a designee, to enter into and execute a Contract with
  Glendale Youth Alliance in an amount not to exceed $645,770 from the WIOA federal
  grant for the period of July 1, 2026, to June 30, 2027
  3. Authorizing the City Manager, or a designee, to enter into and execute a Contract with
  City of Burbank in an amount not to exceed $145,500 from the WIOA federal grant for
  the period of July 1, 2026, to June 30, 2027
  d. Libraries, Arts, and Culture, re: Mural Permit - Design Review Fees
  1. Resolution amending the “Mural Design Review Fee – Small Commercial Business
  (up to 10 employees)/Non-profit/standard”, “Mural Design Review Fee – Small
  Commercial Business (11-50 employees)”, and “Mural Design Review Fee – Small
  Commercial Business (>50 employees)” in the Comprehensive Citywide Fee
  Schedule for the Fiscal Year 2026-2027

6.  CITY COUNCIL/STAFF COMMENTS (Including reports from conferences and regional
  meetings)

7.  COMMUNITY EVENT ANNOUNCEMENTS (3-minutes per speaker)
  Members of the public will be permitted to announce upcoming events taking place in the
  community.

8.  FIRST PERIOD OF ORAL COMMUNICATIONS (Maximum 3 minutes per speaker, 30-minute
  aggregate speaking time limit)
  Members of the public may address the Council on agenda items or non-agenda items within
  the City Council’s subject matter jurisdiction. If a speaker addresses the Council on an agenda
  item during the First Period of Oral Communications, they may not speak again when the
  agenda item is called. A speaker who addresses the Council on non-agenda items during the
  First Period of Oral Communications may not speak during the Second Period of Oral
  Communications.

 9.  ADOPTION OF ORDINANCES

  a. Police Department, re: Introduction of Ordinance Prohibiting the Act of Scavenging

  1. Introduction of an Ordinance of the Council of the City of Glendale, California,
  Amending Section 8.44.050 and Adding Section 8.44.065 of the Glendale Municipal
  Code, 1995, Relating to Refuse, Yard Trimmings and Recyclable Material Collection

  Without the Consent and Over the Objection of the Permittee, or Otherwise
  Interfering with a Permitted Commercial Special Event (Continued from September
  22, 2026 meeting)
  1. Introduction of an Ordinance of the Council of the City of Glendale, California, Adding
  Section 5.88.050 of the Glendale Municipal Code, 1995, Relating to the Commercial
  Special Event Permit
  c. Public Works, re: Agreement Award for As-Needed Citywide Furniture Design,
  Procurement and Installation Services
  1. Resolution to dispense with competitive bidding and authorize the City Manager, or a
  designee, execute agreements with Margaret C. Pett Inc. and J K Milkin Inc. using
  pricing obtained from nationally competitively bid contracts under the California
  Multiple Award Schedules (CMAS) purchasing program for citywide furniture
  procurement, in a cumulative amount not to exceed $300,000 over a three-year term
  d. Finance, re: Fiscal Year 2027-28 Budget Development Public Engagement Plan
